text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on species distribution modeling of rubber trees (Hevea brasiliensis) under climate change using MaxEnt. While it maps climatically suitable areas for rubber cultivation, its primary objective is ecological/species-focused—not land use/land cover (LULC) prediction. It does not model or project actual LULC change; instead, it predicts climatic suitability for a single crop. The study is regional (Western Ghats and Brahmaputra Valley), not national-scale across all of India. Although it uses future climate scenarios (2020, 2050), it lacks explicit national spatial implementation, quantitative LULC accuracy metrics, and mapped LULC projections—only suitability probabilities are shown. Thus, it fails core inclusion criteria (national scale, primary LULC focus, LULC outputs) and meets exclusion criteria: species-specific/ecological focus unrelated to LULC and regional-scale analysis.)
